kindHints.pages: Pages such as About, Contact and the legal pages. A page at /pages/your-address is added automatically.

fields.categoryHint: Questions with the same heading are shown together.
fields.question: Question
fields.linkHint: A path on this site such as /faq, or an https address. Leave both link fields empty for no link.

fields.label: Name
fields.srcHint: An https address, or a path on this site such as /placeholders/hero.svg. Only placeholder or licensed images.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: API keys let another tool use the admin API; webhooks tell another tool when something happens. Every change needs your authenticator code and is recorded in the audit log.
integrations.keysIntro: A key can only do what you choose from your own permissions, never anything that needs an authenticator code. It stops working when it expires, when you revoke it, or when its owner is disabled.
integrations.hooksIntro: We send a signed notice to the address for each chosen event. Notices carry identifiers only, never personal details.
integrations.copyNow: Copy it now and store it safely. It will not be shown again.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.invalid: Check the details: the address must be public and use https, and you can only choose permissions and events you have.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.intro: Add your own fields to races, packages and suppliers. They show up on the forms, in the filters and in the CSV files straight away.
customFields.listTitle: Fields for this kind of record
customFields.listCaption: Custom fields, in the order they appear on forms
customFields.empty: There are no custom fields for this kind of record yet.
customFields.editHelp: The key and the type cannot change. To use a different type, archive this field and add a new one.
customFields.archiveHelp: Archiving hides a field from forms, filters, CSV files and the website. The values already saved are kept, and they come back if you restore the field.

fields.label: Label
fields.labelHint: What staff see next to the field.
fields.keyHint: Lower case letters, digits and underscores, such as bib_colour. Leave blank to make one from the label. It cannot change later.
fields.optionsHint: Only for the two "choose" types. One per line: a short code, a bar, then the label, such as small | Small. Add "| retired" to stop offering a choice without losing the values already saved.
fields.required: Required when a record is created
fields.visibleToCustomer: Show to customers on the website

alerts.intro: Tell us your email and we will write once when a package for this race opens. We will ask you to confirm your address first, and you can unsubscribe in one click from any email.

alerts.tooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
